_comment: Copy this file to data/artifacts/{folder}/{id}.json. Folders are organizational; the `category` field below is the literal artifact type (registry | file), independent of which folder it lives in. Locked schema, 15 fields exactly — see feedback_artifektx_schema memory.
name: Human-readable artifact name
os_min: Earliest OS version this artifact applies to, e.g. Windows 8
purpose: One to two sentences: what this artifact records and why it exists
normal_baseline: What this looks like on a clean, unremarkable system
anti_forensic_notes: How this artifact is commonly cleared, evaded, or is inherently unreliable — and what that absence itself signals
interpretation: Analyst decoding guidance that doesn't fit the fields above: sub-key/value meanings, format quirks, capacity limits, what this artifact proves vs doesn't prove. Added 2026-09-06 after reviewing the SANS FOR500 poster's own Description/Location/Interpretation structure — leave as empty string if there's nothing beyond what purpose/key_fields/anomalies already cover.
